text.tspan: An autonomous multi-agent quantitative system that continuously evaluates Alpaca equity
portfolios, reasons over multi-hypothesis option hedge structures, enforces deterministic
risk gates, and autonomously rebalances collars and spreads under market volatility shifts.

g.text: Real-time IV surface analysis & regime shift detection
Collar, Put Spread, & Tail Risk optimization
Strict VaR, margin sufficiency & Greeks boundary checks
Automated multi-leg order dispatch & delta-drift tracking
TECH STACK: PYTHON 3.11 • FASTAPI • POSTGRESQL + NEON • LANGGRAPH • ALPACA TRADING API • REACT 18 + TAILWIND • JETBRAINS MONO
